basic_info.description: A rare opportunity to own this incredible Crocker Amazon 1920's Modern home with a large lot and downtown views! Featuring 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom with an gracious floorplan. The living room features a wall of windows to showcase the downtown views and wood burning fireplace.  In addition to a formal dining room, the eat-in kitchen includes a built-in dining booth. The home sits on an oversized lot with front and rear landscaping. There is a full basement and 1 car garage.  This home awaits your architectural plans and dreams. Ready to be expanded and modernized! Enjoy neighborhood amenities including easy access to Crocker Amazon & McLaren Parks, freeways, transportation, local shops and restaurants.
